title: Marketplace lite integration checklist and hero copy proposal
summary: Lightweight partner listing playbook for SMB and ISV partners that need a quick, low-friction marketplace tile with minimal engineering lift. Includes acceptance checklist, required technical gates, telemetry requirements, and 8 hero/tile copy variants for A/B testing.
content:
Context:
This doc proposes a "lite" marketplace integration track for partners who want a fast, low-effort listing in the cloud marketplace (tile + trial + basic telemetry) without full deep integration (SaaS connector or managed private deployment). Goal: reduce time-to-publish to 2–3 sprints while maintaining security, telemetry, and billing integrity.

Audience and use cases:
- SMB ISVs who want to offer Redwood-hosted inference via our hosted API with simplified entitlements.
- Channel partners who prefer a self-serve tile with limited support obligations.
- Internal product & legal reviewers who must sign off on acceptance gates.

Principles for "Lite" track:
1) Minimal custom infra: partner supplies marketing copy, logo, 1 sample integration guide. We host and meter usage via existing marketplace trial SKU mechanisms.
2) Standard security baseline: require SOC2-type attestation checklist + allowlist for IP/redirect URIs.
3) Measurable contract: clear trial entitlements (credits, duration), SKU mapping, and telemetry contract (events & dimensions).
4) Fast validation: automated smoke tests + a short manual QA pass before publish.

Acceptance checklist (must pass all items):
- Product & Copy
  - Final hero tile headline (<=90 chars) + 2 supporting bullets (<=160 chars each) provided by partner.
  - 1 short description for marketplace listing (<=500 chars).
  - 2 screenshot images (1200x675 recommended) or 1 animated GIF sample.

- Technical gates (engineering must verify):
  - Trial SKU configured in billing catalog and mapped to partner listing.
  - Entitlement enforcement: trial credits auto-applied on activation, expiration enforced.
  - OAuth redirect URIs registered and reviewed (if OAuth used).
  - API contract: sample curl + SDK snippet validated against hosted API sandbox.
  - CORS and CSP headers reviewed for partner-hosted pages (if applicable).
  - Quota guardrails: soft limits to prevent runaway spend, with automated alerts to partner contact.

- Security & Compliance
  - Partner completed short security questionnaire (answers stored in vendor folder).
  - Minimal data flow diagram (what data touches Redwood infra) included.
  - No PII retention required for the lite integration; if partner asks, escalation path defined.

- Observability & telemetry
  - Must emit the following events to our ingestion: tile_click, trial_started, trial_converted, api_call (aggregated), error_4xx, error_5xx.
  - Provide partner_contact and partner_product_id metadata fields on events.
  - Telemetry sampling targets defined for first 30 days (e.g., 100% of tile_clicks, 10% of api_call payloads).

- QA / Smoke tests
  - Automated smoke test validates: listing renders, trial signup flow issues credits, API sample returns expected mock output, billing meter increments.
  - Manual accessibility spot-check (contrast, alt text) completed.
  - Launch readiness review meeting (30 min) with product, legal, and ops.

Launch timeline (recommended):
- Week 0: Partner intake + security questionnaire sent.
- Week 1: Partner returns copy + assets; GTM drafts listing content.
- Week 2: Engineering hooks up trial SKU + smoke tests; telemetry contract agreed.
- Week 3: QA pass and legal sign-off. Publish in marketplace window.

Rollback & fallback policy:
- If billing mismatches detected in first 72 hours, auto-pause tile and notify partner & ops.
- If telemetry ingestion drops below SLA or we detect anomalous API traffic, move tile to limited availability and open incident.

Operational runbook notes (short):
- Partner support triage: Tier 1 handled by partner; Redwood handles billing and platform incidents. Escalation to partner success at P2.
- Monitoring dashboard: include per-partner trial conversion rate, avg API latency, cost-per-conversion estimate.

Sample hero / tile copy variants (short, distinct options for A/B test):
1) Headline: "Add fast, predictable LLM inference to your app"
   Bullet A: "Turn text into value with per-token pricing and burst-ready capacity."
   Bullet B: "Quick start: sample app + free credits — no infra needed."

2) Headline: "Ship LLM features without GPU ops"
   Bullet A: "Hosted inference with latency and cost controls."
   Bullet B: "Start free — upgrade to reserved capacity anytime."

3) Headline: "Scale AI features with predictable performance"
   Bullet A: "SLA-backed throughput for customer-facing workloads."
   Bullet B: "Built-in fallback & routing across regions."

4) Headline: "Developer-friendly inference, ready to integrate"
   Bullet A: "REST + SDKs, streaming, and function-calling support."
   Bullet B: "Pre-built prompts and evals to keep quality stable."

5) Headline: "Try Redwood inference — credits included"
   Bullet A: "Instant trial, sample demo flows, and 30-day credits."
   Bullet B: "Easy SKU mapping for marketplace billing."

6) Headline: "LLM features with enterprise controls"
   Bullet A: "Private deployments, KMS integrations, and audit logs."
   Bullet B: "Migrate from hosted to private with the same API."

7) Headline: "Reduce per-token cost with smart batching"
   Bullet A: "Automatic caching and batching recommendations."
   Bullet B: "Lower latency while cutting unit cost."

8) Headline: "Ship safer AI with rollout controls"
   Bullet A: "Canary releases, automatic fallbacks, and A/B rollouts."
   Bullet B: "Couple performance and quality metrics in Console."

Recommended tile descriptions (two lengths):
- Short (<=200 chars): "Redwood Inference provides hosted LLM inference with predictable latency, cost-aware controls, and a dev-first API. Start with free credits and deploy production-grade features quickly."
- Long (<=500 chars): "Redwood helps engineering teams ship LLM-powered experiences without GPU ops. Choose hosted inference for fast time-to-value, or upgrade to Dedicated or Private deployments as needs grow. The marketplace listing includes a trial with preconfigured credits, sample SDK snippets, and observability dashboards to track cost and quality across rollouts."

UX snippet for listing detail page (flow bullets):
- CTA: "Start free trial" (opens quick-intake modal: email + workspace)
- Modal step 1: confirm billing & partner name (pre-filled)
- Modal step 2: select trial credits amount (default 5000 tokens)
- Post-activation: success screen with sample curl + link to SDK repo and support contact

Integration friction minimizers (engineering recommendations):
- Provide a small SDK snippet in 3 languages (Python, Node, curl) that works against our sandbox out of the box.
- Use our one-click trial API that mints credits — partners only need to pass partner_product_id.
- Pre-fill region and model recommendations based on tile metadata to reduce configuration steps.

Legal and billing notes (short):
- Use the standard marketplace legal bundle; if partner requests custom terms, escalate to legal — custom terms will add 4+ week lead time.
- Trial credits are non-monetary and expire; conversion occurs on first successful invoiceable usage.

Measurement plan (first 90 days):
- KPI1: trial activation rate (target >= 12%)
- KPI2: trial -> paid conversion (target >= 18% within 30d)
- KPI3: avg API latency for partner traffic (target < 200ms  p95)
- KPI4: error rate (5xx) for partner traffic (target < 0.5%)

Launch checklist (publish day):
- Confirm listing visuals render in marketplace tile preview (desktop + mobile).
- Run smoke tests end-to-end in prod-marketplace staging.
- Confirm billing SKU active and entitlements working.
- Notify partner success and schedule 1-week readout.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Allowed trial credit amounts for "lite" track (default proposal: 5k tokens, optional 20k with justification).
- What level of telemetry payloads are mandatory vs opt-in (privacy tradeoffs).
- Does partner-managed support require an explicit support SLA on listing?

Next steps (owner: Avery Chen):
- Finalize hero copy A/B variants with marketing (due 2025-02-21).
- Add automated smoke test to infra repo and link PR (eng-assigned: Diego Morales).
- Create marketplace SKU and wire trial entitlement (billing: Priya Kapoor).
- Run internal launch-readiness on 2025-03-05 and iterate.

Notes to reviewers: please comment inline with which hero variant you prefer (1–8) and any legal flags on the trial entitlements. This doc is intentionally prescriptive to reduce back-and-forth for small partners; if we need expanded partner flows (connectors or managed deployments) we'll route to the full integration track.
